tank_description: The M551A1 is a highly agile close-range attacker that relies on speed, positioning, and its powerful canister shot to overwhelm opponents before they have a chance to return fire.

strengths.title: Good DPM
strengths.description: The M551A1 has the lowest reload timer of all conventional cannons. Shell to shot in 4 seconds or under making you able to get shots where other tanks couldn't. Combined with Canister Volley giving high burst potential, skilled M551A1 players can ensure an enemies quick return to spawn.

strengths.title: Good Staying Power
strengths.description: Whilst the HP pool and token armour may suggest otherwise, the M551A1 has an ace up it's sleeve. Manual Emergency APS is a powerful ability that means this tank is able to be consistently present in a fight. Coupled with its high mobility, skilled commanders will be an ever present thorn in the side of their enemy.

strengths.title: Good Build Variety
strengths.description: The M551A1 gives players many options to fit their playstyle. Want more burst potential? it has it. Want to survive better in a fight?, it has it too. Players can choose what fits them best without taking something away from it.

weaknesses.title: APHE Shells
weaknesses.description: The M551A1 only has access to APHE shells for its main form of firepower. Whilst it loses no damage on distance it suffers when dealing with shields or ERA heavily. Placing your shots is key to being able to get the most out of this tank as wild, panicked, or poorly aimed shots may do 0 damage.

weaknesses.title: Low Base Damage
weaknesses.description: Even though the M551A1 has great DPM, it's base damage per shot can be low. M551A1 commanders as a result may find them having to dedicate extra engagement time to finishing off wounded opponents on low health making a scavenging playstyle challenging.

tank_summary: The M551A1 is a small, highly agile attacker built for aggressive close-quarters combat. Its excellent mobility allows it to quickly reposition, flank opponents, and exploit openings in the enemy line. Armed with a devastating canister shot capable of punishing targets at short range, the M551A1 excels when fighting up close and keeping pressure on distracted enemies.

To improve its survivability, the vehicle is equipped with an Active Protection System (APS) that can intercept a single incoming large-calibre round. This gives the M551A1 a brief window of protection during engagements and can be the difference between survival and destruction when used at the right moment. Skilled commanders can leverage this advantage to make bold plays and escape situations that would otherwise be fatal.

Despite these strengths, the M551A1 is one of the most fragile vehicles on the battlefield. Its armour provides only token protection, meaning virtually every enemy tank can penetrate it with ease. Combined with its modest 2,300 hit point pool, mistakes are punished severely. Success in the M551A1 depends on mobility, positioning, and timing, ultimately making the M551A1 more of a scavenger than a pure attacker.
